concept.name: Parts of a circle

concept.description: A circle has a centre. The radius is the distance from the centre to the edge. The diameter goes across the circle through the centre and is twice the radius. The circumference is the distance around the circle.

concept.name: Series circuit
concept.subject: Physics
concept.description: In a series circuit there is only one loop. The current is the same everywhere in the loop. The voltage of the cell is shared between the components.

svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500" width="800" height="500">
  <title>GCSE Physics Series Circuit Diagram</title>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="800" height="500" fill="#ffffff" />

  <!-- Main circuit wires (single loop) -->
  <line x1="150" y1="120" x2="650" y2="120" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="4" />
  <line x1="650" y1="120" x2="650" y2="380" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="4" />
  <line x1="150" y1="380" x2="650" y2="380" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="4" />
  <line x1="150" y1="120" x2="150" y2="230" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="4" />
  <line x1="150" y1="270" x2="150" y2="380" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="4" />

  <!-- Cell (Battery) at the left -->
  <line x1="130" y1="230" x2="170" y2="230" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="6" />
  <line x1="140" y1="250" x2="160" y2="250" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="6" />
  <line x1="130" y1="270" x2="170" y2="270" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="6" />
  <line x1="140" y1="290" x2="160" y2="290" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="6" />

  <!-- Component 1: Resistor 1 (Top) -->
  <rect x="330" y="100" width="140" height="40" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="4" rx="4" />

  <!-- Component 2: Resistor 2 (Bottom) -->
  <rect x="330" y="360" width="140" height="40" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="4" rx="4" />

  <!-- Animated Current Flow Indicators (Top wire: Left to Right) -->
  <circle cx="250" cy="120" r="6" fill="#ff3333">
    <animate attributeName="cx" values="200;600;200" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
  </circle>
  <circle cx="400" cy="120" r="6" fill="#ff3333">
    <animate attributeName="cx" values="350;750;350" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
  </circle>

  <!-- Animated Current Flow Indicators (Bottom wire: Right to Left) -->
  <circle cx="550" cy="380" r="6" fill="#ff3333">
    <animate attributeName="cx" values="600;200;600" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
  </circle>
  <circle cx="400" cy="380" r="6" fill="#ff3333">
    <animate attributeName="cx" values="450;50;450" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
  </circle>

  <!-- Educational Text Labels -->
  <text x="400" y="60" font-size="24" font-family="monospace" font-weight="bold" fill="#000000" text-anchor="middle">Series Circuit</text>
  
  <text x="400" y="90" font-size="14" font-family="monospace" font-weight="normal" fill="#555555" text-anchor="middle">Current is the same everywhere in the single loop</text>

  <text x="400" y="155" font-size="16" font-family="monospace" font-weight="bold" fill="#000000" text-anchor="middle">Resistor 1</text>

  <text x="400" y="350" font-size="16" font-family="monospace" font-weight="bold" fill="#000000" text-anchor="middle">Resistor 2</text>

  <text x="90" y="265" font-size="16" font-family="monospace" font-weight="bold" fill="#000000" text-anchor="middle">Cell</text>

</svg>

concept.name: Photosynthesis
concept.subject: Biology
concept.description: Plants take in carbon dioxide and water. They use light energy, absorbed by chlorophyll, to make glucose and oxygen.

svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500" width="800" height="500">
  <title>Photosynthesis GCSE Biology Diagram</title>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect x="30" y="30" width="740" height="440" rx="10" ry="10" fill="#f4f9f4" stroke="#2c5e2a" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Title -->
  <text x="400" y="70" font-size="22" font-family="monospace" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1c3b1a">Photosynthesis in Plants</text>

  <!-- Plant Stem and Leaves -->
  <rect x="385" y="270" width="30" height="150" fill="#73937e" stroke="#2c5e2a" stroke-width="2"/>
  <ellipse cx="320" cy="300" rx="70" ry="40" fill="#4c9a2a" stroke="#2c5e2a" stroke-width="2"/>
  <ellipse cx="480" cy="300" rx="70" ry="40" fill="#4c9a2a" stroke="#2c5e2a" stroke-width="2"/>
  <ellipse cx="400" cy="240" rx="90" ry="50" fill="#4c9a2a" stroke="#2c5e2a" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Sun (Light Energy) -->
  <circle cx="400" cy="130" r="35" fill="#ffcc00" stroke="#ff9900" stroke-width="3">
    <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.7;1;0.7" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </circle>

  <!-- Labels -->
  <text x="400" y="136" font-size="14" font-family="monospace" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" fill="#000000">Light</text>
  <text x="160" y="200" font-size="16" font-family="monospace" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1c3b1a">Carbon Dioxide</text>
  <text x="160" y="225" font-size="14" font-family="monospace" text-anchor="middle" fill="#333333">From the air</text>
  
  <text x="640" y="200" font-size="16" font-family="monospace" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1c3b1a">Glucose</text>
  <text x="640" y="225" font-size="14" font-family="monospace" text-anchor="middle" fill="#333333">Made in leaf</text>

  <text x="160" y="380" font-size="16" font-family="monospace" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1c3b1a">Water</text>
  <text x="160" y="405" font-size="14" font-family="monospace" text-anchor="middle" fill="#333333">From the soil</text>

  <text x="640" y="380" font-size="16" font-family="monospace" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1c3b1a">Oxygen</text>
  <text x="640" y="405" font-size="14" font-family="monospace" text-anchor="middle" fill="#333333">Released out</text>

  <!-- Animated Particles (Inputs moving towards plant) -->
  <circle cx="270" cy="210" r="8" fill="#555555">
    <animate attributeName="cx" values="250;340;250" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </circle>
  <circle cx="270" cy="370" r="8" fill="#3366ff">
    <animate attributeName="cx" values="250;340;250" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </circle>

  <!-- Animated Particles (Outputs moving away from plant) -->
  <circle cx="530" cy="210" r="8" fill="#ffcc00">
    <animate attributeName="cx" values="460;550;460" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </circle>
  <circle cx="530" cy="370" r="8" fill="#00ccff">
    <animate attributeName="cx" values="460;550;460" dur="3.5s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </circle>

</svg>

concept.name: States of matter
concept.subject: Chemistry
concept.description: In a solid the particles are close together and vibrate in place. In a liquid they are close but move past each other. In a gas they are far apart and move fast.
